0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Philadelphia 76ers visit the New York Knicks, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip), while Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring), and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, and the teams last met in the 2026 playoffs, when the Knicks beat the 76ers 144-114 in Philadelphia, a series the 76ers lost 0-4.
